input: Get a quote for professional window cleaning

gold.taskTitle: Get a professional window cleaning quote
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to obtain a price quote from a professional window cleaning service.

questions.title: Is this for a home or a commercial building?
questions.description: Determine whether the property needing window cleaning is residential or commercial.

questions.title: How many windows does the property have?
questions.description: Find out the approximate number of windows to be cleaned.

questions.title: Are any windows on upper floors or hard to reach?
questions.description: Identify if there are high or difficult-to-access windows that require special equipment.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred date to get this done?
questions.description: Understand the user's timeline or urgency for scheduling the cleaning.

questions.title: Do you want quotes from multiple companies to compare?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants one quote or several competing quotes.

questions.title: Is interior cleaning needed, or exterior only?
questions.description: Determine the scope of the cleaning job — inside, outside, or both.

questions.title: What is the location or zip code of the property?
questions.description: Capture the geographic location to find relevant local service providers.
